cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# MicroLink (vendored, components/microlink) is found as a project component.
# Secrets (Wi-Fi, Tailscale auth key) live in sdkconfig.secrets, which is
# git-ignored and generated by `tm config` from secrets/secrets.env.
set(SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS "sdkconfig.defaults")
# `tm build --prod` sets TM_PROFILE=prod: test hooks off, quieter logs.
if("$ENV{TM_PROFILE}" STREQUAL "prod")
    list(APPEND SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS "sdkconfig.prod.defaults")
endif()
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sdkconfig.secrets")
    list(APPEND SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS "sdkconfig.secrets")
endif()

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
# lwIP's NAPT table (exit node / subnet router, CONFIG_ML_SUBNET_ROUTER) is
# allocated on the heap when forwarding starts: 512 entries by default, ~16 KB,
# too much for this no-PSRAM board. 128 entries (~4 KB); the oldest entry is
# evicted when it is full. Unused while forwarding is off.
idf_build_set_property(COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "IP_NAPT_MAX=128" APPEND)
project(tailmote_phase3)
